quotes.excerpt: I thought it was a good call. I thought we had a breakdown on defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajakovic on the team's late-game execution and defensive discipline
quotes.excerpt: Our defense was rock solid. We did really good job. It just on that one play.
quotes.quote: It was one minute and three seconds to go with 102-102. Up till to that point, our defense was rock solid. We did really good job. It just on that one play, that's discipline, that's a little bit of youth. A couple of things can go into that, but I thought that overall we sustained even longer period of discipline and of execution tonight than we did even two days ago.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the late game loss to the Knicks: It was a matter of discipline and youth on that one play, but overall the team sustained execution longer than they did two days ago.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajakovic on the unique challenges of fourth-quarter basketball
quotes.excerpt: We are learning what it means to win in a fourth quarter, and that fourth quarter basketball is different.
quotes.quote: We are learning what it means to win in a fourth quarter, and that fourth quarter basketball is different. Fourth quarter basketball is going to be different in sense of referees, the whistle is going to tighten up. It's going to be different. You got to by that time, you got to already know what is the criteria in the game. I think fourth quarter is it comes down to simple execution and it can be a little bit of luck.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the learning curve of fourth quarter basketball: The whistle tightens up and you have to understand the criteria of the game to succeed.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the challenges and differences of playing basketball in the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajakovic addresses the team's ongoing struggles with free-throw shooting
quotes.excerpt: If you make eight more free throws, it would be even closer game, or we would win it.
quotes.quote: If you make eight more free throws, it would be even closer game, or we would win it by that time. Free throws are there is no other way. You got to step on the line and knock down shot and you got to put the work in. Our guys are in the gym, they're putting the work in, they're really trying to to address that. There is a balance of how much work you're putting in and a balance of just like step on the line and knock down a shot without making it a mental barrier.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic addresses the Raptors free throw struggles: You have to step on the line and knock down the shot without making it a mental barrier.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic addresses the team's ongoing struggles with free-throw shooting.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajakovic on the high volume of blitzes faced by Scottie Barnes
quotes.excerpt: This might be the most blitzes that Scottie Barnes has seen in his career.
quotes.quote: I got to take a look more at the film. They were super aggressive. You got to be able as a five-man coming to set those screens to slip out earlier so there is no actually two players on the ball so you can create a gap there. This is, I'm not sure, but this might be the most blitzes that Scottie Barnes has seen in his career. Even when he was getting the ball in a pocket pass, he was not really sure where to go, what to do. I think there is going to be a lot of good teaching and learning clips from this game.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Scottie Barnes may have faced the most blitzes of his career against the Knicks, noting that Barnes was unsure how to react to the pressure.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic analyzes the defensive pressure and blitzes faced by Scottie Barnes during the game.

quotes.summary_phrase: Rajakovic on the miscommunication during the late-game defensive breakdown
quotes.excerpt: It was a miscommunication. We did not good enough job of being physical and leading the main man.
quotes.quote: It was a miscommunication. We did not good enough job of being physical and leading the main man to the screen and then it created a little bit of miscommunication there.
